text:
samir: Heads-up: rolling out L90e dedicated micro-pools to af-east (Nairobi) and sa-east (Sao Paulo) next week. Primary intent: regional low-latency inference for recommender and personalization teams. Reservations open 2026-06-01 06:00 UTC via Console/API. :globe_with_meridians:
clare: Is this physical expansion or remapped capacity? Any difference in burst behavior?
samir: Physical expansion 1 1 new racks in each region. SLA for reserved capacity: 99.85%. Burst policy: short bursts allowed up to 10% of pool capacity for 3-minute windows, 3x/day during preview. Burst throttles stricter first 48h.
ops-bot: Initial allocations: af-east (Nairobi) = 28 units (7 clusters), sa-east (Sao Paulo) = 30 units (6 clusters). Per-org preview cap: 8 units.
deploy-bot: Rollout plan: canary -> regional ramp -> GA. Canary starts 2026-06-01 06:00 UTC. Monitoring hooks + perf tracing enabled.
clare: Perf expectations vs existing L90?
samir: Tuned for inference: expect p50 ~50ms for 6k context int8 on 2-unit reservations; p95 ~150ms. We'll publish bench sheet.
partners: Any special billing flags / preview SKUs?
finance: Preview uses sku l90e.region.preview and is not billed until conversion to a committed reservation or GA opt-in. Conversion offers include prorated credits for active L90 commitments within 60 days. Contact billing@redwood.com for quotes.
clare: API example (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/dedicated/reservations \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"region":"af-east","gpu_type":"l90e","units":2,"term_months":6}'
```
samir: Quota increases via Console > Support > Dedicated quotas. Expect 24-72h turnaround for preview requests.
samir: I'll host a 20m walkthrough in #dedicated tomorrow 09:00 EAT to walk through reservation flow and migration notes. Ping me for a short demo slot. :calendar:
